 Order
% 10.02.2023
The present application under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks following reliefs:
"a) Call for the records pertaining to complaint dated 27/01/2022 being Criminal Case no. 375/2022 titled as Food Safety Officer Versus State through Food Safety Officer Mr. Akshay Bhalla Versus Rajiv Goel & Ors. pending in the Ld. court of Smt.
Nabeela Wali, ACMM- 01/New Delhi District, Patiala House Court, New Delhi;
b) Quash the being Criminal Case No. 375/2022 U/s 3, 23, 26, 27, 52, 58, 59, 63 of the Food Safety and Standard Act 2006 (hereinafter the FC Act) titled as Food Safety Officer V/s Rajiv Goel and Ors pending before the Ld. court of Smt. Nabeela Wali,
ACMM-01/New Delhi District, Patiala House Court, New Delhi all proceedings/orders emanating therefrom qua the Petitioner who has been arrayed as Accused No 3;
c) Set aside/quash the summoning order dated 15/07/2022 and all proceedings/orders/ coercive steps emanating therefrom qua the petitioner; and d) Pass such other or orders, and as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
